title: Theme for typtorial
description: Fonts, colors, brand text and layout of a tutorial. Every setting is optional; missing ones are taken from the package's themes/default.theme.yaml and then from the values built into typtorial.

fonts.description: Font families. Each is one family or a list of fallbacks; the first one installed on the machine that compiles the tutorial is used.

sizes.description: Font sizes in pt. The website scales its own sizes by the same proportions.

colors.description: Colors as hex values, e.g. "#ffc800". Empty values fall back to the next theme in the lookup order.

background-gradient.description: Second color for a gradient towards the bottom right. Empty = solid background.

accent.description: Progress dot and underline of the title.

heading-background.description: Bar behind the heading of a step. Empty = no bar.

line.description: Separator lines, small dots and borders.

code-text.description: Text color in the code panel. Empty = same as text.

header.description: Background of the header. Empty = the page background shows through.

header-text.description: Text color of the header. Empty = same as text.

button.description: Copy button of the website. Empty = same as code-background.

button-text.description: Text of the copy button. Empty = same as code-text.

title-background.description: Background of the title page. Empty = same as the other pages.

title-text.description: Text color of the title page. Empty = same as text.

abstract-background.description: Background of the abstract page. Empty = same as the other pages.

abstract-text.description: Text color of the abstract page. Empty = same as text.

brand.description: Brand text shown at the top right. A logo is passed to the tutorial function as `logo: image("logo.svg")`.

text.description: Text at the top right. "" hides it.

dots.description: Progress dots next to the heading; they link to the other steps.

corner-radius.description: Rounding of the code panel. 0 = square.

code-border.description: Thin line around the code panel.

title-underline.description: Underline the title at the top left in the accent color.

title-uppercase.description: Title at the top left in capitals.

text-position.description: Vertical position of a step's heading and text.

title-page.description: Start with a page that shows the title large and centered.

abstract.description: Where the abstract goes: on a page of its own, or below the title on the title page (needs title-page).

dark.description: Values for the dark color scheme. Anything missing falls back to the light values. A theme with its own colors but without this section has no dark scheme.
